profile.headline: Software Engineer at Chewy
profile.summary: Proficient in Python, Java, and Javascript. Experience working with Django, PyQt, jQuery, and bootstrap. Graduated from Johns Hopkins University in 2013 with a Bachelors in Chemistry and a Minor in Voice.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Produced analytics products for energy and gas market clients.
- Created a multi-market visualization suite for energy market billing data.
- Redesigned structure of client database.
- Started frontend + backend unit testing suites.
- Improved performance of energy market data scraping/analysis processes.
- Created a customer-facing API for data and reports.
- Languages/Technologies: Python Django, JS, PostgreSQL, AWS, VueJS, Docker, Tableau, ReactJS, Sentry
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Back-End Web Development · Computer Science

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed a flexible portfolio analytics tool for investors in private markets.
- Utilized temp table caching to increase sql query performance.
- Started and managed a testing suite to ensure code stability and calculation accuracy.
- Planned code sprints.
- Increased user traffic with a "daily news" feature.
- Communicated with customers and participated in sales meetings with over 30 companies and potential clients.
- Languages/Technologies: Python, Django, Javascript, KendoUI, PostgreSQL, AWS
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Back-End Web Development · Computer Science

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Built a social network for sharing audio tracks.
- Integrated the Google Maps API to allow for visualization of nearby music.
- Created 'search for nearby user' feature. Introduced change in search radius for all searches.
- Languages/Technologies: Javascript, AngularJS.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.locationName: Fairfield County, CT and Westchester County, NY
positions.description:
- Full-time science and math tutor.
- Courses included: AP Physics, AP Chemistry, AP Biology, and math through Pre-Calculus.
- Test-prep for: SAT math, SAT II Math 1 and 2, and SAT II Chemistry.
- Maintained daily/weekly communications with students and/or parents.
- Served over 50 families in the NY/CT area.
